newsitem.title: USA: Cycomm International gets Ericsson order.
newsitem.headline: Cycomm International gets Ericsson order.

text.p: Cycomm International Inc said on Monday that Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson ordered 150 PCMobile units from its subsidiary XL Computing Corp.
The initial value of this order from the end user is valued at more than $1 million and will be delivered in the first half of 1997, Cycomm said.
Sweden's Ericsson will deploy the units in police vehicles in Genesee County, Mich., the company said
Albert Hawk, president and chief executive of Cycomm, said that this is the company's largest single order to date from Ericsson under their recently signed agreement.
